summary: Discussion-first signals: Google tightening MCP for Workspace agents and Gemini Task tab/sandbox push; several operator-facing incidents (Grok leaks, Notion MCP upsell) and a DeepSeek CVE. Mix of mainstream vendor moves, user-workflow reports, and infra/security primitives to follow up. | Vendor-sourced agent infra, product releases, and security advisories: JetBrains, Cloudflare, Mistral, Microsoft product deltas; E2B/OpenAI operational workflows; multiple GHSA advisories affecting agent primitives. | Github-only snapshot: multiple vendor releases (Langfuse, Dify, Vercel, Cloudflare, Anthropic) and many repo signals for agent infra (sandboxes, MCP taps, security layers). Lacking social/operator reports to validate real-world operator workflows. | Package-layer signals: multiple agent infra primitives (memory, MCP, safety), notable mainstream vendor VS Code agents/extensions, and operator-facing VS Code workflows; several single-repo packages need corroboration.
